description: mta_sts_fetcher.rs line 161 (test): let body_str = body.to_string() where body is a &str literal. The idiomatic form for converting &str to String is .to_owned() (clippy::str_to_string). .to_string() works but goes through the Display trait — .to_owned() is the direct conversion that signals intent.
title: mta_sts_fetcher.rs test: body.to_string() on &str literal
